headline: Krispy Kreme Posts 43% EBITDA Growth as Turnaround Gains Momentum
summary: By Karen Roman Krispy Kreme, Inc. (Nasdaq: DNUT) said second quarter adjusted EBITDA grew 43.2% to $28.8 million, and net revenue decreased 12.8% to $331.0 million due to its refranchising strategy and the closure of underperforming stores.
